description: Ministry of Plantation - Amend the licencing of Produce Brokers Act, No. 9 of 1979
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Plantation under the Licensing of Produce Brokers Act, No. 9 of 1979. It specifically amends existing regulations regarding license fees, renewal fees, and definitions for produce brokers in the tea industry. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory framework modifications.
